description: Workers in loincloths haul a large stone block on a wooden sledge with ropes while a figure in a blue crown and collar stands on a mound directing them. Behind them stand scribes with scrolls, a tall obelisk, a row of stone columns with wooden scaffolding, and palm trees along a Nile shore with sailing boats. The scene is warm, sandy and painted in oil style, with no visible text and no frame.
